shot-01.character_action: She sings straight to the lens and holds the phone at chest height
shot-01.lyric_text: I sing my BlackCEO Drama Song / I built this Factory demo for owners / I feel the rhythm lift my day
shot-01.necessity: The hook line names the product, so the first shot must carry it
shot-01.viewer_understanding: A real shop owner is singing the product name in her own doorway

shot-02.change_from_prior: She moves from the doorway to the counter and the laptop enters frame
shot-02.character_action: She steps to the counter and gestures toward the laptop while she keeps singing
shot-02.lyric_text: I keep the beat rolling in my heart / I turn my shop story into music / I watch my customers nod along / I let the Drama Song carry my pitch
shot-02.necessity: The offer line needs a visible place for the demo to happen
shot-02.viewer_understanding: The offer sits on the counter of the same shop she just sang in

shot-03.change_from_prior: The frame widens from her to the whole shop
shot-03.character_action: She opens her arms to the room and finishes the last line on a held smile
shot-03.lyric_text: Visit BlackCEO dot com and book the demo / Hear what your brand sounds like sung / Start today and let the tune travel / BlackCEO Drama Song Ad Factory starts here / Book the demo before the week ends
shot-03.necessity: The call to action closes the ad and must hold the final beat
shot-03.viewer_understanding: Booking the demo is the next step and the whole shop is behind the ask
